title: Edit Policy-Aligned Text Simplification
abstract: arXiv:2512.06228v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Text simplification aims to modify documents and sentences to make them easier to read and understand while preserving their meanings. Different applications require distinct simplification policies, e.g., lexical-oriented simplification and overall rewriting while trading off detail for simplicity. However, achieving such policy-driven control remains an open challenge. In this work, we introduce a simple yet powerful approach that leverages Large Language Model-as-a-Judge (LLM-Judge) to automatically construct policy-aligned training data, removing the need for costly human annotation or parallel corpora. Our method enables the construction of simplification models that adapt to diverse simplification policies at both the sentence and document levels. translated_title: 编辑策略对齐的文本简化
translated_abstract: 文本简化旨在修改文档和句子，使其更易于阅读和理解，同时保留其含义。不同的应用需要不同的简化策略，例如面向词汇层面的简化，以及以牺牲细节为代价换取简洁性的整体重写。然而，实现这种由策略驱动的控制仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种简单而强大的方法，利用大语言模型作为裁判来自动构建与策略对齐的训练数据，从而无需昂贵的人工标注或平行语料库。我们的方法能够构建在句子和文档两个层面都能适应多种简化策略的简化模型。值得注意的是，小规模的开源大语言模型在性能上达到甚至超越了GPT-5，这一点已通过自动指标和编辑分析得到验证。该方法在各个模型家族和模型规模上都带来了一致的改进。
tldr: 该论文提出利用大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-Judge）自动构建与简化策略对齐的训练数据，无需人工标注或平行语料库，即可训练出在句子和文档层面适应多种简化策略的模型，且小规模开源模型的性能可媲美甚至超越GPT-5。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a simple yet powerful approach that leverages LLM-as-a-Judge to automatically construct policy-aligned training data without costly human annotation or parallel corpora, enabling simplification models to adapt to diverse policies at both sentence and document levels, with small-scale open-source LLMs matching or surpassing GPT-5.
